QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] The Great Escape
QuestInfo.0: You managed to escape Fire Raccoon Finance in one piece. You should speak with Kubinashi and Kamaitachi.
QuestInfo.1: It seems that Kubinashi has had a change of heart... Is she still going to duel Kamaitachi?
